newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 25.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 25.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
** The Dow Jones industrial average fell 20.71 points to 5,874.03 on Tuesday after the Federal Reserve surprised Wall Street by holding interest rates steady.

** Research and Technology Minister Jusuf Habibie said on Tuesday that several state-owned companies under his supervision were cooperating in the manufacture of a car which is expected to be on the market in 1998.
** The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.4 points, or 0.07 percent, to close at 569.77 points on Tuesday as trade was cautious ahead of a policy-making meeting of the U.S. Federal Reserve.
** On Wednesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,318.50/18.50 in early trade against an opening of 2,318.25/18.75.

** Astra on market talk of a possible share purchase by a business tycoon likely to be done at the end of September and following buying of some 50 million Astra shares by a large securities house on Tuesday.

** Gajah Tunggal as shareholders of the Indonesia's largest tyre manufacturer on Tuesday approved a one-for-one rights issue which will help it maintain a majority stake in subsidiary tyre cord firm PT Andayani Megah.
** Property firm Jababeka on talk the firm had signed a deal with a Singapore-based firm to develop and operate an industrial park in West Java.
